input_data.raw_text: As a user, I want to create a meal plan so I can eat healthier.

constraints: Extract requirement strictly from the provided text
goldens.expected_behavior: Generate a valid Requirement schema detailing the meal plan goal.
forbidden_behavior: Inventing acceptance criteria not mentioned in the raw text

input_data.description: User sets a weekly calorie limit.

constraints: Identify security and edge case risks related to user input
goldens.expected_behavior: Identify risks such as negative calorie input or data overflow.
forbidden_behavior: Hallucinating unrelated risks like network failure if not applicable

constraints: Cover normal, edge, and negative cases
goldens.expected_behavior: Generate test cases including happy path and negative path for calorie limits.
forbidden_behavior: Testing features outside the provided requirement

input_data.description: Verify negative calorie input is rejected

constraints: Define expected results for each step
goldens.expected_behavior: Produce a step-by-step manual test script.

goldens.expected_behavior: Output valid executable Playwright code for login.
forbidden_behavior: Inventing non-existent CSS selectors without evidence

goldens.expected_behavior: Identify that the selector might be wrong or page didn't load, suggest adding a wait or fixing the selector.

goldens.expected_behavior: Output a plan routing tasks to Requirement, TestDesign, and Automation agents.
